data.name: NoOneKnowsME.
data.detailed_description:
Overview & Story

The protagonist has taken over the body of a deceased crew member. Blending in with the others, you must navigate daily life aboard the spaceship without being detected. Survive for 7 days without revealing your true identity.

Playtime

Approximately 1 hour

Gameplay Videos & Streaming

You are free to stream and create videos of this game. However, we would greatly appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam page in your video description.

Concept

Reach Earth without the humans discovering what you truly are.

Key Features

  • 7 Days, 7 Tasks: A new task awaits you each day.

  • The Growing Unease: Every task starts normally, but halfway through, something begins to feel... "off."

  • Maintain the Facade: Even as you sense the creeping dread, you must remain calm to avoid raising suspicion. Experience a thrilling blend of suspense and tension.

Character Development

You play as an entity that has possessed a human. Initially, the protagonist struggles to mimic human behavior convincingly. However, as they gradually adapt to their new form, they begin to lose sight of who they truly were...

Objective

Complete various tasks over seven days and safely reach Earth.

Game Mechanics

Overcome 7 distinct trials (tasks) and navigate 7 crucial conversations with the crew.
